title: Inference Output
description: Predictive maintenance inference result returned by the AI serving path (via FastAPI)

status.description: High-level health status (e.g. normal, anomalous, faulted)

fault_type.description: Predicted fault class, or null when status is normal

rul_hours.description: Estimated remaining useful life in hours; null if not applicable

shap_top_part.description: Component/feature with highest SHAP contribution for the prediction

roi_savings.description: Estimated cost savings / ROI figure associated with early intervention (currency units TBD by team)

model_version.description: Version tag of the model/artifact bundle used for this inference
